comment: What the SM8550 display engine on fuxi exposes, read from the live device tree (fuxi-live.dts, decompiled from /sys/firmware/fdt on 2026-11-14). These are the controller-side facts a display driver needs; the panel-side facts are in panel_facts.json and the DSI command blobs in panel_cmds_*.txt.
source: /sys/firmware/devicetree/base on the device, 2026-11-14. Device tree integers are big-endian cells; the offsets below are the driver's own register offsets inside the mapped windows, not physical addresses.

mdp.sde_off: 0x1000, the MDP block inside the first window

dsi.note: The panel is on ctrl0/phy0: qcom,dsi-display-primary selects qcom,dsi-ctrl = <0x2e 0x35> and qcom,dsi-phy = <0x36 0x37>, and the stock kernel command line names the same panel (msm_drm.dsi_display0).

reserved_memory.note: demura_heap_region and non_secure_display_region exist as nodes; read them before enabling demura, which this build leaves off.

panel.identity: 0bba0c4e (persist/display/screenColorCal_panelInfo.txt, also in the stock command line as msm_drm.oled_wp)
panel.geometry: 1080x2400, DSI command mode, burst, DSC 8 bit/component, 8 bit/pixel, slices 540x40 x2
panel.commands: facts/panel_cmds_*.txt: on 718 bytes, off 89 bytes, timing-switch 79 bytes, plus doze/HBM/FOD/dimming

power_supply.entries: qcom,panel-supply-entry@0..2, the three rails the panel needs before its reset sequence
power_supply.note: All three have to be up before the on-command sequence; the stock driver votes them through RPMh.

bringup_order: 1. Firmware GOP scanout: confirm the UniXNU menu shows with correct colours and geometry (porting/display step 1).
2. Read the pipes the firmware left: VIG0/1 source, size, format, CTL state, tear check, and the display stream in the apps SMMU.
3. Panel init: three rails up, reset sequence, then the 718-byte on-command.
4. DPU scanout at the 120 Hz timing, 8-bit BGRA framebuffer.
5. Swaps: publish completion only after the GPU wrote everything handed to it before the swap arrived.

runtime_verified.comment: Read from the stock Android system while it was running the panel, over adb root on 2026-11-14. These are the values the msm_drm driver actually programmed, which is stronger evidence than the device tree alone: the tree says what the panel can do, this says what the driver chose.

geometry.cutout: top centre, 68 px wide, 121 px tall (Rect(506,0 - 574,121)), spec M 0,0 H -34 V 121 H 34 V 0 H 0 Z

colour.note: The per-unit colour LUTs are in .cache/firmware/fuxi-persist/display (LUT_P3_D65_0.txt, LUT_sRGB_D65_0.txt, input_XYZ.txt) and the panel identity 0bba0c4e in screenColorCal_panelInfo.txt.

runtime_verified.dependencies: The MDP platform device lists its suppliers: af00000.clock-controller, 1600000.interconnect, 1780000.interconnect, 17a00000.apps_rsc:drv@2:rpmh-regulator-mmcxlvl, 24100000.interconnect, af20000.disp_rsc / af20000.qcom,sde_rscc, and regulator.7. Those are the votes the display bring-up has to make before the pipes work.
runtime_verified.what_this_does_not_give: The register-level values the driver wrote (clk_summary and the SDE debug nodes are not exported on this build, and there is no /dev/mem), so the register step still has to come from the device tree offsets plus the reference probe.
